svg.title: Decoder score matrices
svg.desc: Three actual checkpoint score matrices share the same logit color scale, with illegal self cells masked and true target facts outlined.
svg.text: Fixed encoder, trained decoder: scores for seed 17
Rows are query heads; * marks test heads. Black outlines: positive facts, used only for display.
Common color scale: blue = -5, white = 0, orange = +5. Values are logits, not probabilities.
Gray self cells are excluded from all legal ranking candidates; no_graph scores are tied.
DistMult scores are symmetric; full bilinear scores can differ when head and tail exchange.
